whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Figtree Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has a great location near Buddha Smriti Park in Patna, but your current website link points to a hotel domain (alinahotels.com) instead of a dedicated cafe experience.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom mobile-first live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table booking, digital menu, aur atmosphere showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/figtree

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Figtree Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We noticed your current link points to a hotel page, so we built a dedicated cafe experience with a digital menu and table reservation buttons tailored for your Fraser Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
